name: Document - Reassign Document

parameters.query: WITH upd AS (UPDATE {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_incoming SET assignee_id = CASE WHEN NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN COALESCE($1::text, '') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN ($1::text)::uuid ELSE assignee_id END, status = CASE WHEN NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND status = 'received' THEN 'processing' ELSE status END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE (NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND id = NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid) OR (NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL AND NULLIF($4::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND assignee_id = NULLIF($4::text, '')::uuid AND status != 'done') RETURNING id, so_van_ban as doc_code, trich_yeu as title), dist AS (INSERT INTO {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_distributions (document_id, document_type, recipient_dept) SELECT id, 'incoming', LEFT(TRIM($3::text), 100) FROM upd WHERE COALESCE(TRIM($3::text), '') <> '' RETURNING recipient_dept) SELECT upd.doc_code, upd.title, (SELECT recipient_dept FROM dist LIMIT 1) AS recipient_dept FROM upd;
SELECT mattermost_user_id FROM users WHERE COALESCE($1::text, '') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND id = ($1::text)::uuid;
